description: Hand-marked rim lines of the skater's upper (right) gauntlet, round 10 (2026-10-02). Pixel coordinates in the 1800-px working image of each derived still (scripts/figure_views.load_view(view, 1800)), read from 40-px gridded crops. 'rim' = the visible upper lip of the cuff opening (highlight edge); in 0.00 s the near (inner) lip of the opening is also visible. The cuff's outer boundary is taken from the colour segmentation in scripts/cuff-overlay.py, not marked by hand. status: traced (manual), uncertainty about 6-10 px (motion blur).
